description: Pat and Mat move from household technology and cooking into bigger projects involving moving house, water, gardening, painting and even homemade flight, consistently solving each new problem by building a more complicated one.

s02e01.description: When the record player stops working properly, Pat and Mat repair the mechanism, the records and then the damage caused by their repairs until making music themselves begins to look simpler.

s02e02.description: Frozen food proves unexpectedly difficult to prepare on the grill, so Pat and Mat keep redesigning the cooking setup until their modest meal has become a full construction project.

s02e03.description: Pat and Mat load their belongings for a move, trying to fit an implausible amount of furniture and household gear onto a small convertible without abandoning anything they consider essential.

s02e04.description: At their country place, Pat and Mat discover that the well is dry. Their search for water leads from digging to increasingly ambitious ways of reaching the nearby river.

s02e05.description: Watching birds and insects inspires Pat and Mat to try flying themselves, prompting a succession of homemade devices that treat aerodynamics as something best discovered by trial and error.

s02e06.description: After damaging a garden ornament, Pat and Mat decide to replace it with something of their own making, and the simple repair grows into an oversized garden-building project.

s02e07.description: A small cleaning job leaves the ceiling worse than before, so Pat and Mat decide to repaint it and devise increasingly inventive ways to cover the entire surface.

s02e08.description: One of Pat and Mat becomes so absorbed in a crossword that an unattended iron causes a household problem. Rather than stop puzzling, they build a machine intended to handle the ironing for them.
